deploy.startCommand: echo 'DATABASE_URL is set:' && echo $DATABASE_URL | head -c 30 && echo '...' && echo 'Starting migrations...' && alembic upgrade head 2>&1 && echo 'Migrations done, starting server...' && gunicorn app.main:app --workers 1 --worker-class uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --timeout 120 --access-logfile - --error-logfile -
